row.body: The fuel can carries a tag for a field run; the receipt says the driver paid for a full tank, though the return check found it nearly empty.
row.title: Fuel for the field run

sidecar.gloss: A field run has a fuel receipt that conflicts with the return check.
sidecar.rival_reading: An evacuation trip could consume the same fuel; the mismatch does not identify who drove or where.
